verdict.rationale: Typesense's own comparison page says it combines typo-tolerant keyword search with direct vector search and hybrid search. Its GitHub README also links a live semantic/hybrid search demo over 300K HN comments. missing for 10: in-depth docs on how vector and keyword scores are fused (e.g. rank fusion weighting), explicit confirmation that both run in a single query request, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run hybrid search — semantic vector similarity fused with keyword matching — in a single query

citations.quote: Typesense combines typo-tolerant keyword search with direct vector search, hybrid search, semantic search, and geo search.
Semantic / Hybrid search on 300K HN comments: hn-comments-search.typesense.org
